cards.card_text: Next, God gives Moses a formula with the finest spices: liquid myrrh, cinnamon, fragrant cane and cassia, weighed out by the shekel, plus a hin of olive oil.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Take the finest spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half that amount (250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane, 500 shekels of cassia—all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.
cards.snippet: …fragrant cane, 500 shekels of cassia—all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.

cards.card_text: God wants honest ___ and weights, plus an honest ephah and an honest hin.
cards.verse_text: You shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin.
cards.snippet: …shall maintain honest scales and weights, an honest ephah, and an honest hin.

cards.card_text: His water gets measured too, a sixth of a hin, drunk at set times.
cards.verse_text: You are also to measure out a sixth of a hin of water to drink, and you are to drink it at set times.
cards.snippet: You are also to measure out a sixth of a hin of water to drink, and you are to drink it at set…

cards.card_text: On top of that comes a grain offering: an ephah for each bull and each ram, with a hin of olive oil for each ephah.
cards.verse_text: He shall also provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a hin of olive oil for each ephah of grain.
cards.snippet: …for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a hin of olive oil for each ephah of grain.
